title: USS Constitution

services.name: Hours + Admissions
services.desc: USS Constitution (the ship) is owned by the United States Navy and operated separately from the Museum. Visit USS Constitution’s website for more information on visiting the Ship. The Museum is closed for Thanksgiving, Christmas Day, and New Year’s Day and has an early closure at 2:00 PM on December 24th. The Ship is also closed on Martin Luther King, Jr.’s Birthday, Thanksgiving, Christmas Day, and New Year’s Day. Visit USS Constitution’s website for more information about visiting the Ship. The USS Constitution Museum is proud to offer several discounted or free admission programs to individuals, families, and groups. Visit our Ways to Save page to find out
